bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,stat
p=Path('scripts/userbot_topic_entry_audit.py')
data=p.read_bytes()
if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()!='cc9d498d1161c06e74e93739999e89e0e2832d648076d496dbe2f9b02514d48e':
 raise SystemExit('AUDIT_RUNTIME_VERSION_CHANGED_BLOCKED')
if b'LEGACY_PIN_IDS' not in data or b'if page < 0:' not in data:
 raise SystemExit('AUDIT_OWNER_INSPECTION_MISSING')
session=Path('deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session')
if not session.is_file() or stat.S_IMODE(session.stat().st_mode)!=0o600:
 raise SystemExit('SESSION_UNSAFE')
print('OWNER_AUDIT_CODE_PRECHECK=PASS')
PY
deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python -m py_compile scripts/userbot_topic_entry_audit.py
python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health | grep -q 'USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=PASS'
inode_before="$(stat -c %i deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session)"
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service
okay=0
for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do
 if python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=PASS'; then okay=1; break; fi
 sleep 2
done
test "$okay" -eq 1 || exit 71
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(stat -c %i deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session)" = "$inode_before"
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,sys
for chat,topic in [(-1003847210571,273),(-1002373696859,1724),(-1002373696859,4291),(-1003770334893,18)]:
 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'scripts/userbot_topic_audit_client.py','--chat-id',str(chat),'--topic-id',str(topic)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=125)
 if p.returncode:raise SystemExit('LEGACY_READBACK_UNAVAILABLE')
 a=[json.loads(x.split('=',1)[1]) for x in p.stdout.splitlines() if x.startswith('USERBOT_TOPIC_AUDIT=')]
 if len(a)!=1 or len(a[0].get('rows',[]))!=1:raise SystemExit('LEGACY_AUDIT_SHAPE_FAILED')
 pin=a[0]['rows'][0].get('legacy_pin')
 if not isinstance(pin,dict):raise SystemExit('LEGACY_AUDIT_NOT_LOADED')
 print('EXISTING_PIN_AUTHOR',chat,topic,pin.get('sender_role'),bool(pin.get('message_exists')))
print('EXISTING_PIN_AUTHOR_READBACK=PASS')
PY
echo USERBOT_SESSION_PRESERVED=PASS
